gloss: Keep the reasons behind a shared decision readable by everyone it binds
mechanism: Each shared {{decision}} is recorded with its reasons, the alternatives rejected and why, and who decided, in a place everyone the decision binds can read. People who were not in the room can then follow, question or revisit it.
invariants: Each shared decision records its reasons, the rejected alternatives and who decided.
The record is readable by everyone the decision binds.
failure_modes: Reasons in the room: only the deciders know why the decision was made.
Post-hoc reasons: reasons are written after the fact to fit the decision.
